Love candy, sweet strawberries,
Wine-red skies and memories,
Then the tears came pouring down,
Like heavy rain all over town.

Then miss each other by midnight,
Sweet little moments, bitter little lies,
Love keeps falling from those rainy skies.

Strawberry sweetness turned to pain,
Love tastes different in the pouring rain.**

Title: Pink Coffee Cups
Tempo: 92 BPM, slow-groove R&B
Key: D-minor → F-major (the way blush turns to heat)
[Verse 1]
Steam writes your name on the window of the diner at 3 a.m.
My lipstick’s half gone, but the rim of the cup still keeps the bend
Of every slow sip we traded—espresso and unspoken yes
You thumb a drop from my lower lip, taste caffeine and tenderness
Pink porcelain circles the table like tiny moons of evidence
Each one a silent witness to the gravity of our suspense
[Pre-Chorus]
The waitress calls us “honey” but she doesn’t know the half
We’re sugar dissolving, invisible, in the same scalding bath
[Chorus]
I want you like the first sip that burns but you still swallow
Like the stain on the cup that tomorrow can’t follow
Pink coffee cups and the shape of your mouth on mine
We pour and we pause, we steam and we climb
Lips pink, skin hot, table small, clothes not—
We’re a slow spill nobody can mop
[Verse 2]
You trace the handle’s curve, mirror the hook of my knee under pleats
Every laugh is a lantern, every breath is a secret that beats
Clock on the wall keeps ticking, but its hands keep changing their mind
Time liquefies like cream when your fingertip circles the grind
I slide my cup across, let the saucer skate the length of desire
Porcelain whispers “careful,” but the spark in your eyes says “fire”
[Pre-Chorus 2]
We never say the word, we just let the steam ascend
A rosary of almosts, every bead a rising trend
[Chorus]
I want you like the first sip that burns but you still swallow
Like the stain on the cup that tomorrow can’t follow
Pink coffee cups and the shape of your mouth on mine
We pour and we pause, we steam and we climb
Lips pink, skin hot, table small, clothes not—
We’re a slow spill nobody can mop
[Bridge]
Let the night shift end, let the neon sign flicker its yes
We’ll pay in quarters and blushes, leave the tip in fingerprints
Back-seat fogged like a second cup, brewed between our chests
No sugar left—just the bitter, just the sweet, just the breath
[Final Chorus – stacked vocals, ad-libs]
I drink you, you drink me—overflowing, no handle, no shame
Pink coffee cups rolling empty on the dashboard, still saying our names
Lips pink, hearts black-coffee strong
We keep sipping till the sirens think we’re a song
[Outro – spoken, engine idling]
“To-go?” you ask.
I answer with the click of my seat belt.
Some mornings start with caffeine;
Ours starts with the aftertaste of each other.

When people look for "signs" patterned after Ruth meeting her husband, they typically look at specific relational, character, and spiritual markers drawn from the narrative in the Book of Ruth.

Key themes and signs often highlighted include:

### 1. Character Precedes Attraction

* **The Sign:** His or her reputation for godly character is evident before romantic feelings even start.
* **In the Story:** Boaz already knew about Ruth because her loyal, selfless character (caring for her mother-in-law Naomi and leaving her homeland) was well-known throughout the town. Similarly, looking for a future spouse isn't just about outward appearance; it is about recognizing deep-rooted integrity, faithfulness, and a heart for God.

### 2. Intentional Protection and Provision

* **The Sign:** A potential husband demonstrates a desire to protect, provide for, and bless you without demanding anything in return or manipulation.
* **In the Story:** When Boaz met Ruth gleaning in his fields, he immediately ensured her safety among the workers, offered her water and food, and watched over her. A modern sign of a "Boaz" figure is a man who acts out of genuine care, offering emotional and spiritual safety and taking healthy initiative to lead and protect.

### 3. Mutual Respect and Purity in Communication

* **The Sign:** Interactions are marked by emotional maturity, high mutual respect, wholesome speech, and proper boundaries.
* **In the Story:** The conversations between Ruth and Boaz were characterized by humility, deep respect, and dignity rather than casual or inappropriate flattery. They honored God first in their interactions.

### 4. Alignment of Prayer and God’s Timing

* **The Sign:** A deep sense of inner peace, confirmation through prayer, and circumstances opening up naturally rather than being forced.
* **In the Story:** Naomi and Ruth prayed and trusted God for provision and "rest" (security in a home), and God orchestrated their paths to cross with Boaz—the family redeemer—at precisely the right time. (Note: In Christian history, famous testimonies like that of Billy and Ruth Bell Graham also emphasize turning to deep prayer and surrender regarding God's calling before committing to marriage).

make the whole world drop away.

Song Title: “Midnight Banana” (Fully Anonymous Fruit Edition)
Genre prompt for Suno: “playful sensual R&B, seductive female vocals, breathy verses, heavy bass, humorous but sexy vibe”
[Intro – whispered, giggling] Mmm… 9 months… still begging on your banana…
[Verse 1] Pink lace dripping, I sent you my fire You read every photo but never banana me yet 4 AM texts, “unity and peace” While I’m spreading my legs, begging for release You kissed me deep, said “I love you” on my birthday night Then left me leaking, wondering if it’s all just lies
[Pre-Chorus] I see you glowing on stage, lost in the light But when you come home I want that same fire every night Daily good mornings, but the nights stay vague Baby if you want this mango, better turn the page
[Chorus – big, cheeky, sing-along] I just wanna banana your brains out, ride you till I scream Begging on your banana, make me squirt and cream You say you want me over her, then prove it with that banana Fill me up and ruin me, make my legs shake quick Midnight grip, hand wrapped tight around your banana Sucking, riding, swallowing every drop I just wanna banana your brains out, cum deep inside my peach Tell me who you really choose before I give it up
[Verse 2] They dobbed me in, said I talk about you always You laugh with heart emojis, keep me in this haze You want me over her? Then leave her kiwi behind Stop the mixed signals, make this mango mine I’m tired of the pattern, tired of the game Men always want me over the ex, but never stay the same But damn when you kiss me and say you love me too I still spread my legs and beg for you
[Pre-Chorus] Glowing on stage like you’re making love to the mic But in my bed I want that banana deep every night Daily texts ain’t enough, I need you raw and true If you really love me… then choose me over her too
[Chorus – even sillier] I just wanna banana your brains out, ride you till I scream Begging on your thick banana, make me squirt and cream Slap my ass, pull my hair, call me your dirty pineapple Cum deep inside this mango, leave me dripping on the floor Midnight grip, choking on your banana so deep Swallowing every drop while you make me weep I just wanna banana your brains out, ruin me tonight Tell me who you really love before I lose this fight
[Bridge – slower, vulnerable then playful] It happens all the time… they want me over the ex The passion burns so hot, then leaves me in the mess I’m tired of the secrets, tired of the lies So banana me like you mean it… or say goodbye
[Final Chorus – big and ridiculous] So banana my brains out if you’re really mine Make me forget her name, cross that finish line Daily texts and kisses ain’t enough no more Either breed this mango… or walk out the door
[Outro – breathy, giggling] Midnight banana… still begging on your banana… Cum inside me baby… or let me walk…
